Title: Some users' calls are failing in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users' calls are failing in Microsoft Teams.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Teams and checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 30 minutes.

Title: Some users' calls are failing in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users' calls are failing in Microsoft Teams.

More info: Specifically, reports from affected users indicate that PSTN direct routing calls for certain accounts associated with call queues in Microsoft Teams aren't being connected.

Current status: We're reviewing and analyzing user-provided service logs and contextual details to assist with our investigation and determine our next troubleshooting steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is impacted by this event, and some users making calls in Microsoft Teams are affected.

Next update by: Friday, October 16, 2026, at 5:00 AM UTC

Title: Some users' calls are failing in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users' calls are failing in Microsoft Teams.

More info: Specifically, reports from affected users indicate that Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) direct routing calls for certain accounts associated with call queues in Microsoft Teams aren't being connected. Additionally, resource accounts and auto attendants associated with these call queues may not receive inbound calls.

Current status: We're continuing to review user-provided service logs and call logs to gain insight into the underlying source of impact and determine our next steps.

Scope of impact: Your organization is impacted by this event, and some users making calls in Microsoft Teams are affected.

Next update by: Friday, October 16, 2026, at 9:30 AM UTC

Title: Some users' calls may fail in Microsoft Teams

User impact: Users' calls may fail in Microsoft Teams.

More info: Specifically, reports from affected users indicate that Public Switched Telephone Network (PSTN) direct routing calls for certain accounts associated with call queues in Microsoft Teams aren't being connected. Additionally, resource accounts and auto attendants associated with these call queues may not receive inbound calls.

Current status: We’ve identified a potential issue with cached information not updating as expected following phone-number assignment changes. We’re reprovisioning the affected resource account-to-phone number association as an initial mitigation and monitoring the results to validate our root cause hypothesis and determine whether additional steps are required.

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to users attempting to make calls to phone numbers that have recently undergone assignment changes in Microsoft Teams.

Next update by: Friday, October 16, 2026, at 1:30 PM UTC
